AVGO.thesis: Broadcom can capture more value per AI deployment by supplying workload-optimised custom accelerators and networking across both GPU and ASIC architectures. Google TPUs, Meta MTIA, OpenAI and Anthropic programs create growth opportunities as inference economics favour specialised chips; these programs are not all at the same stage of commercial deployment. VMware and other infrastructure software provide recurring cash generation and diversification. The thesis depends on customer programs reaching volume, durable software renewals, and AI demand translating into cash rather than increasing credit exposure. Higher rates and economic weakness can slow hyperscaler investment and make financing-dependent AI customers less able to pay; Broadcom's own leverage and contingent customer financing obligations amplify this risk.
AVGO.confirmation: Q4 comes in near or above management’s $21.7 billion AI sales and 66% adjusted operating margin outlook. In FY2027, look for more than one customer program to reach volume, sustained software growth, and free cash flow that keeps pace with operating profit. Confirm customer diversification, independently funded deployments, stable or improving cash conversion, and falling net leverage without increased risk-adjusted customer financing exposure.
AVGO.invalidation: Repeated deployment delays, weaker software renewals, or deteriorating margins and cash conversion despite AI sales growth. Rising customer lease exposure would also weaken the thesis if the extra risk absorbs cash as shipments scale. Thesis weakens materially if hyperscalers cut capex, customers insource custom silicon, AI developers struggle to monetise compute, or guarantees/loans grow faster than cash generation.
drivers: AI was about 56% of Broadcom’s Q3 revenue. Track accelerator shipments alongside demand for the networking used in the same clusters.
Watch software growth alongside disclosed VMware renewal and adoption indicators to gauge the durability of the increase.
$13.7 billion in fiscal Q3 free cash flow
About 46% of revenue. Compare future cash conversion against this baseline as AI rack deployments scale.
Google supply agreements through 2031; Meta plans through 2029

Google and Meta are disclosed partners; Anthropic is an identified TPU compute end user, and OpenAI is a separate announced accelerator program. Do not infer individual revenue shares or equate commitments with shipments.
Monitor networking sales and design wins across GPU and custom accelerator clusters; custom silicon adoption is not the only growth path.
risks: Top five end customers: 55% of Q3 FY2026 revenue vs 40% a year earlier

One distributor accounted for 50% of direct revenue in Q3; this is a different measure from end-customer concentration. Monitor program delays, insourcing, pricing pressure and concentration each quarter.
Up to ~$29 billion at full deployment
The Q3 filing disclosed this maximum potential liability for the described backstop. No payments had been made as of the filing. Track deployed exposure and any actual payments.
Watch for slower segment growth or weaker renewals as customers decide whether to expand VMware Cloud Foundation.
Up to $42 billion note purchase facility in Anthropic preliminary prospectus

The facility had no outstanding principal as of September 30, 2026 per preliminary prospectus. Track actual draws, collateral, conversion terms, residual value guarantees and losses; do not add the facility, $29 billion backstop and $63 billion financing transaction without reconciling overlap.
Higher rates, weaker AI monetisation or recession
Capex cuts, higher credit spreads, project delays and customer funding constraints can impair orders and collections; software diversification mitigates but does not eliminate exposure.
Net debt, interest expense and free cash flow
Monitor net debt/EBITDA, interest coverage, receivables and operating cash flow versus earnings, including cash committed to customer financing.
catalysts: Compare reported results with guidance of $34.8 billion total revenue, $21.7 billion AI semiconductor revenue and 66% adjusted operating margin. Check free cash flow and FY2027 shipment commentary.

The $63 billion financing structure supports purchases of Broadcom accelerators and networking systems for lease to Anthropic. Watch for first deliveries and updates on Broadcom’s residual-value support.

The June unveiling confirmed engineering samples were running. The original plan targeted initial rack deployments in the second half of 2026. Look for a dated production shipment or customer deployment update.
Track infrastructure software growth against the Q3 baseline of 29% and look for VMware Cloud Foundation renewals and paid production deployments of Private AI Cloud.
Next filing · AI rack lease exposure
Check whether maximum backstop exposure rises as racks deploy, and watch for any payments, revised terms or changes to the accounting disclosure.
Google and Meta · Custom silicon adoption

Positive: new volume shipments, repeat designs and expanding networking attach. Negative: delays, customer insourcing, lost designs or pricing pressure. Google and Meta agreements establish programs, not guaranteed revenue.
Quarterly · Hyperscaler capex and AI returns

Positive: sustained AI capex backed by monetisation and operating cash flow. Negative: project cancellations, declining AI capex guidance, weak utilisation or capex growth persistently outpacing returns.
Quarterly · Anthropic financing and credit exposure

Positive: independently funded deployments, stronger customer liquidity and limited Broadcom draws or guarantees. Negative: increasing drawn balances, expanded guarantees, payment delays or impairment. Reconcile the note facility and lease structures before aggregating exposure.
Quarterly · Customer concentration and balance sheet

Track top-five end-customer share versus Q3 55%, direct distributor share separately, net debt/EBITDA, interest coverage and FCF margin versus Q3 46%. Positive: diversification and deleveraging; negative: rising concentration, leverage or falling cash conversion.
Nov 2026 · Anthropic IPO and strategic investment

SEC filing confirms IPO closing and concurrent private placement including Broadcom; track actual customer cash resources, cash burn and financing draws rather than assuming an IPO removes credit risk.
